card.name: Before drug exposure measures in interaction text
card.fires_on: The last word of a drug name, or 'the' or 'its' after a verb like reduced or increased, right before a pharmacokinetic measure such as AUC, Cmax, clearance or exposure. It appears in drug-interaction sections.
